content_metadata.description: This video captures Jason's exciting journey from Tokyo to Los Angeles to meet the legendary guitarist Eddie Van Halen, including the signing of a special guitar.

qAndA.answer: The video begins at the Shibuya Scramble Crossing in Tokyo, Japan.
qAndA.question: Where does the video begin?
What day of the week is it at the beginning of the video?
What special event is Jason attending in Los Angeles?

qAndA.answer: It's a red and white EVH guitar with a black pickguard.
qAndA.question: What kind of guitar does Eddie Van Halen sign for Jason?

qAndA.answer: He's going to hang it on the wall in his music store in Shibuya, Tokyo.
qAndA.question: What does Jason plan to do with the signed guitar?

text_to_speech: Greetings world this is Jason from Ishibashi Music, Shibuya in Tokyo. I'm currently just around the corner from our store in the world famous Shibuya scrambled crossing. It is now the Saturday night before the 2017 NAMM show and on Monday I'm taking off a couple of days early before the show because on Tuesday I'm going to Rock & Roll hallowed ground and am gonna meet with an honest-to-god true legend in our industry of Rock & Roll and electric guitar. I'm so excited so come along with me for an exclusive hello from a very, very awesome dude. Let's go!!! So here I am. I told you I was coming up for something special and I am with... Eddie Van Halen. It doesn't get any bigger than this folks. Eddie thank you so much for letting me come to 5150 (studio) today. My pleasure man. I'm glad to have you. This has been really cool. I brought something special with me. I brought a guitar the way from Tokyo with me to get signed. Would you mind signing it for us today please? My pleasure and an honor. Jason: Thank you so much. Eddie: There you go. Jason: That's incredible. Cool man. I'll give you the guitar and I'll take away the pen. So this guitar is going to be hanging up on the wall in the in the Shibuya store in Tokyo where I am based. So if you wanna come down to the store if you're in Japan, come to Tokyo, come to Shibuya, come get a photo taken with the guitar to that because it will be hanging on the wall in our store. Ahh, while you've got an audience is there anything you wanna say to the world? Well first of all I'd like to thank you for coming all the way out here. I wanna thank Ishibashi for all your support for EVH. I wanna say hi to everyone out there and wish you a kick-ass 2017, and a very, very happy new year.

youtube_description:
NOTE: I no longer work for Ishibashi Music.
On Tuesday January 17th 2017, I had the most amazing opportunity to visit 5150 Studio & meet the legend himself Eddie Van Halen. Hit play, enjoy the journey along with me and be sure to share the video. Filmed & Edited 100% by Jason the interviewer. For more of my work: www.jasonmcnamara.net

For more information on EVH Guitars & Amps go to: www.evhgear.com

Filmed 100% on GoPro cameras with thanks to Audio Technica & Zoom for the audio recording equipment.

Zoom F4 field recorder: https://www.zoom-na.com/products/field-video-recording/field-recording/zoom-f4-multitrack-field-recorder
